patch.summary: ClickFunnels cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: ClickFunnels pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: ClickFunnels cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ClickFunnels against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 14-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (social scheduling, funnel builder, landing pages) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Creators and info-product marketers building sales funnels requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: No forever-free plan — paid entry from Launch

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: All-in-one funnel breadth can be heavier than a dedicated ESP

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Social listening/ads are not the center of gravity

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Plan limits and add-ons need live confirmation

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not an enterprise B2B MAP like Marketo

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs ClickFunnels on identical constraints.
